market_definition: The India Power Line, Utility Asset & Vegetation Management Drone Market covers companies delivering the following. Products and technology: Aerial platform: drone, helicopter, satellite; sensor: LiDAR, RGB, thermal, corona camera; analytics: vegetation growth modeling, thermal anomaly detection, asset-risk scoring. Services and business models: Corridor mapping, vegetation-clearance analysis, thermal inspection, predictive maintenance, storm-response assessment, digital twin development. Applications: Transmission-line inspection, distribution-line inspection, substation inspection, vegetation encroachment, wildfire mitigation, storm damage assessment, asset inventory. End users: Electric utilities, renewable-energy operators, gas utilities, cooperatives, municipal utilities, EPC firms, government agencies. Geography: India -- companies HEADQUARTERED IN India (a foreign company's Indian office, branch or distributor does not qualify).
